sessionSummary.goal: Integrate local AI (Ollama) for clothing analysis and outfit creation in mockups
completed: Replaced rembg with Ollama-only stack (simplified dependencies)
Created single Go API server for mockups + AI features (port 8556)
Added AI clothing analysis (category, color, brand, tags detection)
Implemented 'Dress with AI' feature for automatic outfit positioning
Added enhanced brand detection with llava:13b model (on-demand)
Updated all image upload to support AVIF format
Fixed direnv infinite loop issue in flake.nix
Integrated all MR MARVIS clothing photos into mockup data

models.enhanced: llava:13b (accurate brand OCR, 2-3 min per image, on-demand)

technologies.mockupServer: Single Go binary serving static files + AI API on port 8556

aiClothingAnalysis.description: Automatic clothing item analysis on upload using Ollama vision model

performance.llava13b: 2-3 minutes per image on CPU (better OCR for brands)

dressWithAI.description: AI-assisted clothing placement on body/mannequin photos
workflow: Upload body/mannequin photo as canvas background
Add clothing items to canvas manually
AI analyzes body proportions and suggests optimal item positions
Items automatically repositioned with proper layering
dressWithAI.returns: X/Y positions (percentages) and Z-index for each item

enhancedBrandDetection.description: On-demand brand detection using larger llava:13b model
enhancedBrandDetection.trigger: User clicks 'Detect with AI (13b)' button on item detail page
workflow: Upload item with llava:7b (fast, basic detection)
Click 'Detect with AI (13b)' for better brand OCR

bodyMannequinUpload.description: Upload body/mannequin photos as outfit canvas background
features: Upload any body photo as canvas background
Auto-layering (click item to bring to front)

aiPromptStrategy.principle: Simpler prompts work better with vision models
aiPromptStrategy.currentPrompt: Concise, direct questions (What type? What color? Read labels for brand?)

brandDetection.solution: On-demand llava:13b button for better OCR
brandDetection.limitations: Even 13b may miss very small or blurry text

direnvLoop.symptom: direnv loading repeatedly, 'Argument list too long' errors
direnvLoop.cause: shellHook in flake.nix was sourcing .envrc which contained 'use flake', creating infinite loop
direnvLoop.fix: Removed .envrc sourcing, added GOTHREADS_SHELL_INITIALIZED check to prevent repeated echo messages

taskfileYamlSyntax.symptom: task: Failed to parse Taskfile.yml: mapping values not allowed
taskfileYamlSyntax.cause: Unquoted colons in task descriptions (e.g., 'task db:migrate:create')
taskfileYamlSyntax.fix: Quoted task description with colons, quoted all task names with colons

cssNotLoading.symptom: User reported plain HTML without styling
cssNotLoading.cause: User likely opening file:// instead of http:// URL
cssNotLoading.fix: Confirmed CSS file intact, reminded to use http://localhost:8556/
cssNotLoading.note: CSS loads fine when served via Go fileserver

performance.cpuOnly: No GPU, all inference runs on CPU

brandDetection.issue: Vision models struggle with small text on clothing labels
brandDetection.workaround: Enhanced 13b model improves accuracy but still not 100%

backgroundRemoval.removed: Initially planned to use rembg, decided Ollama-only stack instead
backgroundRemoval.alternative: Users can use pre-processed images with transparent backgrounds
backgroundRemoval.futureConsideration: Could add rembg back as optional service

resumptionInstructions: IMPORTANT: Mockups are fully functional with AI. Test before backend implementation.
Start with: task mockups:dev && open http://localhost:8556/upload.html
Upload a clothing photo to test AI analysis (llava:7b, 60-90s wait)
Go to item detail page, click 'Detect with AI (13b)' to test enhanced brand detection (2-3min wait)
Go to outfit builder, upload body photo, add items, click 'Dress with AI'
All mockup data persists in localStorage (gothreads_mockup_data key)
When ready for backend: reference mockups/api/main.go as implementation guide
The Go mockup server shows exact API contracts to implement in real backend
